Q8095.reason: By thirteen months, mildly inconsistent care leaves no firmly selective bond, so the infant accepts an unfamiliar adult as an attachment figure.

Q5546.reason: Smoke that drifts over and discolors the neighbor’s home is a trespass because the intentional work with flammables supplies the required intent without any purpose to intrude.
